# Third-party art

These assets are included in the project and are released under CC0 / public domain on their OpenGameArt pages.

- Male player sprite: **Hero character sprite sheet** by Fry. [OpenGameArt page](https://opengameart.org/content/hero-character-sprite-sheet)
- Female player sprite: **Top down player sprite sheet (Julia)** by ArlanTR. [OpenGameArt page](https://opengameart.org/content/top-down-player-sprite-sheet-julia)
- Enemy sprites: **Stalagmite Monster** pack by Some Weirdo (Miteclops and Stalagmite variants). [OpenGameArt page](https://opengameart.org/content/stalagmite-monster)

The game uses the PNG files in this folder. Original sprite sheets are kept alongside the game for easier editing.
